title: Butter Mint Stripe — Rocking Horse Reverie
description: Wide mint-and-butter-yellow stripes frame a vintage rocking-horse corner motif, elevating a chunky rounded baby name to hero status while playful italic body text anchors the party details below.
philosophy: This template exists for celebrations where whimsy must be legible from across a reception hall. It refuses clinical whitespace and sterile grid layouts in favour of tactile stripe rhythms borrowed from vintage cotton nursery textiles. The chunky rounded letterform signals warmth without infantilising the guest list — it scales from printed A5 invitation cards to projected welcome screens with equal grace. The illustrated nursery motif grounds the design in handcrafted nostalgia, deliberately rejecting flat-icon genericness in favour of a specific, era-conscious charm.
goodFor: Baby shower welcome and name-reveal projected slides
Printed A5 or A6 party invitation cards
avoidFor: Corporate brand identity or investor pitch decks
Academic research or data-dense conference presentations
author: harness

examples.promptCore: A dreamy, tactile nursery-textile atmosphere where full-bleed candy-stripe banding sets a gentle rhythmic stage for the hero name — warm, rounded, and commanding from across a room. A vintage rocking-horse illustration anchors one lower corner, evoking handcrafted nostalgia over flat-icon genericness. The mood is affectionate and whimsical, favouring softly weighted asymmetry over clinical symmetry, with the stripe rhythm doing the heavy compositional lifting.

examples.layoutNotes: The slide uses full-bleed horizontal stripes as the primary structural rhythm, with two to three alternating wide bands running edge-to-edge across the full canvas. The hero name sits centered within the dominant mid-stripe band, with generous breathing room above and below amplifying its scaled-up presence. The rocking-horse illustration bleeds into one lower corner as a decorative anchor, creating deliberate asymmetry balanced by open negative space on the opposing side. No persistent header band; any secondary detail such as a host name or date sits at the very bottom edge, small and subordinate to the name.

examples.promptCore: Feels like a folded nursery textile spread open on a table — warm, tactile, and gently festive without being loud. The side-by-side detail cells carry a measured breathing cadence: enough space between them to stay airy, not so much that the design turns cold or sparse. Each text pairing reads with an unhurried, handwritten ease that suits handcrafted celebration rather than announcement-board efficiency. Avoid flat generic icons, sterile data-table grids, and any bullet-list rigidity — the charm lives entirely in the illustrated corner motif and the stripe rhythm that echoes through every horizontal layer.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed horizontal stripe bands frame the top and bottom edges; the content zone occupies a central cream field spanning roughly cols 2–11 of a 12-col grid. Two or three equal-width detail cells sit side by side inside that zone, each headed by a small nursery illustration and followed by italic label-and-value pairs below it. The vintage corner motif (rocking horse) tucks into the bottom-right margin outside the main content columns. No header band or folio number — the bottom stripe tail acts as the visual closer.
